fighter.notes: Chain mail and shield. Fighting Style: Defense. Second Wind (bonus action, 1d10+3 HP, once per short rest). Action Surge (one extra action, once per short rest). Champion: critical hit on 19-20.

rogue.notes: Studded leather. Sneak Attack +2d6 once per turn with advantage or an ally next to the target. Cunning Action: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action. Expertise: Stealth, Perception. Lucky: reroll a natural 1. Thief: Fast Hands, Second-Story Work. Thieves' tools.

attacks.name: Sacred flame (cantrip)
attacks.damage: Dex save DC 13 or 1d8 radiant, range 60

spells: Cantrips: sacred flame, spare the dying, guidance
1st (4 slots): bless*, cure wounds*, healing word, shield of faith, guiding bolt
2nd (2 slots): lesser restoration*, spiritual weapon*, hold person
cleric.notes: Chain mail and shield. Spell save DC 13, spell attack +5. Life Domain: healing spells restore 2 + spell level extra HP. Channel Divinity (once per short rest): Turn Undead or Preserve Life (15 HP split among creatures within 30 ft). Darkvision 60 ft; dwarven resilience. * = domain spell, always prepared.

spells: Cantrips: fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation
1st (4 slots): magic missile, shield, sleep, detect magic, mage armor, burning hands
2nd (2 slots): misty step, scorching ray, hold person
wizard.notes: Spell save DC 13, spell attack +5. Arcane Recovery (once per day after a short rest: regain 2 levels of slots). Evocation: Sculpt Spells. Mage armor makes AC 15. Darkvision 60 ft; Fey Ancestry; trance.
